svg.text: Denny found a candy bucket at the end of a moonlit path. A few silly ghosts and sleepy
bats are floating between the turns.
Help Denny avoid the ghosts and bats and reach the candy bucket.
Bats are mammals, and baby bats drink milk from their mothers.
Free printable maze from Denny's Maze App - www.harmlessapp.com/printables/halloween
